data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German word 'tibalt' which means 'brave in battle'. This name was popular among Germanic tribes and was adopted by early Christians as a name for their warriors. The name Tibold carries the meaning “Brave in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tibold usually hope their child will grow to embody brave in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
